meta.title: Realtime translation (dsh-rt-translation)
meta.description: Live subtitles for the audio your PC is playing: Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, and Cantonese, with on-device recognition and streaming LLM translation in a draggable always-on-top window. System audio only, no microphone; audio never leaves the machine, and only recognized text (plus any translation background you enter) is sent to your model. Open Realtime translation in the sidebar and press ▶ to start.
